requirements_summary: Large-scale clinical RAG/search deployment. ~45M de-duplicated clinical documents (notes, reports, imaging captions). Need low-latency vector retrieval + GPU rerank. Peak expected QPS 3k daily bursts, steady 300-600 QPS. Retrieval latency budget: <100ms for ANN + <50ms for rerank; end-to-end 95th pct <250ms. Cost target: <$0.02/query average across mixed read/write workloads. Must support field-level PHI masking, per-request audit logs to Splunk, tenant-aware access control mapped to SSO groups, and data residency in US regions. Incremental nightly indexing, near-real-time ingest for urgent consults. Require proof of deterministic rerank reproducibility and eval metrics vs current BM25+lambdaMART baseline.
